title: A fixed 377-day HARPS wave gives no clear HIRES error reduction in 215 selected HD 1461 nights
abstract: We test a fixed circular 377-day wave in public HD 1461 velocities. Phase and amplitude fitted to 245 HARPS nights give a 0.72 percent error reduction in 215 independent HIRES nights. A conditional 30-day block range is -3.60 to 4.99 percent. Earth-velocity terms change the trained wave and give negative gains. A common-wave simulation includes training error and gives positive gain in only 50.5 percent of draws for the main fitted amplitude. Thus this test gives no clear support for the long wave and does not exclude an orbit. The known 13.5-day control gives a 17.42 percent gain. Code, source hashes, aggregate results and retrieval steps are included. External source records stay outside the bundle.
